name: Pack for the Flight
description: Decide what goes in the personal item, cabin bag and hold bags, what to wear and what to leave behind, under real airline rules: sizes, litres, weight limits and overweight fees, the 100 ml liquids rule, power banks and sharp items, and must-bring items. The plan is checked rule by rule and compared with the cheapest plan a computer search can find.
hook: Beat the baggage fees without breaking a single airline rule.
author: Gauntlet Real-World Pack

cases.prompt:
Weekend in Lisbon, Friday to Sunday, flying from Manchester. Just me, sightseeing and a nice dinner.

Here is everything I’d like to take. "Replace" is what it would cost me to buy it there if I leave it at home; MUST means it has to come with me.

ID | Item | Weight | Volume | Size (cm) | Replace | Notes
I01 | Passport | 0.05 kg | 0.1 l | 13 × 9 × 1 | MUST | -
I02 | Phone | 0.2 kg | 0.1 l | 15 × 7 × 1 | MUST | -
I03 | Summer clothes (rolled) | 2.2 kg | 11 l | 35 × 25 × 12 | £124.00 | -
I04 | Smart shoes | 1.1 kg | 6 l | 32 × 22 × 12 | £69.50 | -
I05 | Washbag (toothbrush, razor, dry items) | 0.6 kg | 2.5 l | 24 × 14 × 10 | £19.00 | -
I06 | Toothpaste 75 ml | 0.1 kg | 0.1 l | 16 × 4 × 3 | £3.00 | liquid, 75 ml container
I07 | Shampoo 250 ml | 0.3 kg | 0.3 l | 18 × 7 × 4 | £4.00 | liquid, 250 ml container
I08 | Sun cream 50 ml | 0.07 kg | 0.07 l | 10 × 4 × 3 | £6.00 | liquid, 50 ml container
I09 | Paperback book | 0.35 kg | 0.6 l | 20 × 13 × 3 | £8.50 | -
I10 | Power bank (spare lithium battery) | 0.35 kg | 0.3 l | 15 × 7 × 3 | £29.00 | spare lithium battery

AIRLINE RULES (fees are for the whole return trip; the same things come home with me)
- Personal item under the seat: free. Up to 40 × 30 × 20 cm, 20 litres; no weight limit.
- Cabin bag: £36.00. Up to 55 × 40 × 20 cm, 40 litres, 10 kg.
- Hold bags (at most 2): first £48.00, second £55.00. Each up to 75 × 50 × 30 cm, 95 litres and 32 kg. Each includes 23 kg; every kg or part of a kg over that costs £12.00.
- An item fits a bag only if its size fits inside the bag’s size (in any orientation: compare longest with longest, and so on). The volumes of the items in a bag add up and must not exceed its litres; their weights add up too.
- Liquids, gels and pastes in the cabin (personal item or cabin bag): each container at most 100 ml, and all of them together must fit in one 1-litre bag (at most 1,000 ml in total). Any size is fine in a hold bag.
- Spare lithium batteries (power banks) must travel in the cabin, never in a hold bag. Sharp items (scissors with blades over 6 cm, knives, multitools) must go in a hold bag, never in the cabin.
- Things marked "can be worn" can be worn onto the plane instead (they then count towards no bag). Nothing else can be worn.
- You only pay for a bag if you put something in it. The total cost = bag fees + overweight fees + the "Replace" price of everything left at home.

Pack for the lowest total cost while keeping every rule. Answer with where each item goes, using the item IDs, in this JSON format (each hold bag is its own list; anything not listed is left at home):
```json
{"personal": ["<ID>"], "cabin": ["<ID>"], "hold": [["<ID>"]], "wear": ["<ID>"], "leave": ["<ID>"], "total": 0.00}
```
Give exactly one answer as a single JSON block. Do not offer alternatives: a reply that contains two different answers, or an answer that says "or", is marked wrong. You may explain your working before the JSON.
